purpose: Artifact-level public-release disposition for third-party PDFs, scans, and source archives under docs/primary-sources.

policy.public_candidate_rule: Only public_redistribution_verified artifacts may be tracked in the public candidate.
policy.permission_boundary: Citation, attribution, retrieval, DOI, arXiv availability, author hosting, and a source archive are not redistribution permission.
policy.link_and_digest_rule: When permission is not verified but a stable official route and exact digest exist, preserve the source record and consumer mapping and exclude the binary from the public candidate.
policy.unresolved_rule: An artifact without a reproducible official retrieval route or exact digest remains an unresolved_release_blocker until an operator resolves the evidence.
policy.verified_permission_rule: A public_redistribution_verified record must include permission_evidence_scope equal to its exact artifact path and a non-empty permission_evidence_locator.
